name: TensorPM v1.39.1
body:
# Changelog - v1.39.1

This update introduces a new synchronization protocol for cloud workspaces. Changes made at the
same time on several devices are merged instead of overwritten, every automatic decision can be
reviewed and undone, and personal intake stays private until you share it.

## 🔄 Synchronization

- Every record carries a server revision. A change made on an outdated version is detected
  instead of silently replacing a newer one.
- Concurrent edits are merged automatically when they touch different fields. In long texts,
  edits to different paragraphs are both kept. Related fields such as start and due date, status
  and block reason, or the priority settings are always taken together.
- When both sides changed the same field, the newer change wins. Small clock differences between
  devices do not decide the outcome.
- Automatic decisions are listed in the sync panel. Values that were replaced can be restored
  with one click, as long as nobody changed them again since.
- Deleted records are no longer brought back by an offline device. An edit to a record that was
  deleted elsewhere is kept and can be restored explicitly.
- Changes wait safely on the device while offline or when the server is briefly unavailable, and
  a single failing record no longer holds back the rest.
- Project moves between workspaces are transferred as one unit.
- New intake entries are private to you until you share them with the workspace.
- On computers shared by several accounts, files you save or the app creates for you (exports,
  documents, handovers, browser results) stay yours; project folders keep detecting new files.
- Logging out now tells you how many changes are still waiting to be sent and how many need a
  decision; both stay on this device for your next sign-in.

## 🔐 Sign-In Improvements

- A temporarily unavailable or rate-limited server no longer signs you out. Only an account that
  no longer exists ends the session.

## ⚠️ Compatibility

- Older versions keep synchronizing with updated devices. Intake entries created on an older
  version stay on that device.
- The first start after the update prepares the local sync state once; this can take a moment on
  large databases.

## 🏗️ Improvements

- Updated the editor, AI-provider and application libraries to their current versions.

## 📅 Release Info

- **Version**: 1.39.1
- **Release Date**: 2026-09-26
- **Previous Version**: 1.38.2
- **Type**: Minor Release (1.39.0 was not published)
